cocktails.name: White Russian
instructions: Fill a rocks glass with large ice cubes.
Pour the vodka and Kahlúa directly over the ice.
Gently top with the heavy cream.
Stir gently before serving.

cocktails.name: Moscow Mule
cocktails.description: A Refreshing Vodka and Ginger Beer Classic
instructions: Fill a copper mug or highball glass with fresh ice cubes.
Pour the vodka and lime juice over the ice.
Top off with ginger beer.
Stir gently to combine and garnish with a lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktails.description: A Bright and Citrusy Vodka Cocktail
instructions: Add the vodka, Cointreau, lime juice, and cranberry juice to a shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously.
Double strain into a chilled martini glass.
Express the oils from an orange twist over the drink and drop it in.

cocktails.name: Bloody Mary
cocktails.description: A Savory Vodka Cocktail with Bold Flavor
instructions: Rim a tall glass with celery salt and fill with ice.
Combine all liquid ingredients and spices in a cocktail shaker.
Gently roll the mixture back and forth between two shakers to blend.
Strain into the prepared glass and garnish with a celery stalk.

cocktails.name: Negroni
cocktails.description: A Bold and Bittersweet Italian Classic
instructions: Fill a mixing glass with fresh ice cubes.
Add the gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth.
Stir continuously until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube and garnish with an orange peel.

cocktails.name: Gin & Tonic
cocktails.description: A Crisp and Refreshing Gin Classic
instructions: Fill a highball glass or goblet completely with fresh ice cubes.
Pour the gin directly over the ice.
Slowly top with tonic water to preserve carbonation.
Stir gently and garnish with a lime wheel.

cocktails.name: Tom Collins
cocktails.description: A Bright, Citrusy and Effervescent Gin Cocktail
instructions: Add the gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup to a shaker filled with ice.
Shake vigorously until well-chilled.
Strain into a tall Collins glass filled with fresh ice.
Top off with club soda, stir gently, and garnish with a lemon wheel.

cocktails.name: Margarita
cocktails.description: A Bright and Citrusy Tequila Classic
instructions: Rub a lime wedge over the rim of a rocks glass and dip into coarse salt.
Combine tequila, lime juice, Cointreau, and agave in a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into the prepared rocks glass over fresh ice.

cocktails.name: Paloma
cocktails.description: A Refreshing Tequila Cocktail with Grapefruit
instructions: Fill a highball glass with fresh ice cubes.
Add the tequila, fresh lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Top off with grapefruit soda.
Stir gently to combine and garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

cocktails.name: Mezcal Mule
cocktails.description: A Smoky and Refreshing Mezcal Cocktail
instructions: Fill a copper mug or rocks glass with fresh ice cubes.
Pour in the mezcal and fresh lime juice.
Top with cold ginger beer.
Stir gently and garnish with a lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Mojito
cocktails.description: A Fresh and Minty Cuban Classic
instructions: Lightly muddle the mint leaves and simple syrup in a highball glass.
Add the white rum and lime juice.
Fill the glass with crushed ice or ice cubes.
Top with club soda, stir gently to lift the mint, and garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktails.name: Daiquiri
cocktails.description: A Simple and Balanced Rum Classic
instructions: Add the rum, fresh lime juice, and simple syrup to a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously until completely chilled.
Double strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.
Garnish with a lime twist or wheel.

cocktails.name: Piña Colada
instructions: Combine the rum, pineapple juice, cream of coconut, and lime juice in a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously until frothy and chilled.
Strain into a hurricane or tall glass filled with fresh pebble ice.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.description: A Timeless and Spirit-Forward Whiskey Classic
instructions: Add the simple syrup and bitters to a rocks glass.
Pour in the whiskey and add one large ice cube.
Stir gently for 20-30 seconds to chill and dilute slightly.
Express the oils from an orange peel over the glass and drop it in.

cocktails.name: Whiskey Sour
cocktails.description: A Balanced Whiskey Cocktail with Citrus
instructions: Add the bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup, and egg white to a shaker.
Dry shake vigorously (without ice) to emulsify the egg white.
Add ice to the shaker and shake again until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or rocks glass and garnish with drops of bitters.

cocktails.name: Manhattan
cocktails.description: A Refined and Spirit-Forward Whiskey Classic
instructions: Add the rye whiskey, sweet vermouth, and bitters to a mixing glass.
Fill with ice and stir smoothly until well-chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.
Garnish with a brandied cherry.

cocktails.name: Sidecar
cocktails.description: A Classic Brandy Cocktail with Bright Citrus
instructions: Run a lemon wedge along the rim of a coupe glass and dip into sugar.
Add the Cognac, Cointreau, and lemon juice to a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously until chilled.
Strain into the prepared sugar-rimmed glass.

cocktails.name: Brandy Alexander
cocktails.description: A Rich and Creamy Brandy Classic
instructions: Combine the Cognac, crème de cacao, and heavy cream in a cocktail shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously until cold and creamy.
Strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.
Garnish with a light dusting of freshly grated nutmeg.

cocktails.name: French 75
cocktails.description: A Sparkling Cocktail with Cognac and Citrus
instructions: Add the Cognac, lemon juice, and simple syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Strain into a champagne flute.
Top with cold Champagne and garnish with a lemon twist.
